'''Mammoth''' is a map designed for Capture the Flag, initially produced for two CTF events: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/wiki/CTF_Showdown_2|CTF Showdown 2] and on [[CTF_Showdown_qhlan]]. 

It is a non-mirrored map, meaning the bases are somewhat intentionally inbalanced without a mirrored layout. The armors area placed in the outdoor area between the two bases, where also the key weapons and quad are placed in separated areas.
